Hi Diego,

Quick ask — we have a preflight run scheduled tonight on our staging environment to validate a microburst p95 sweep for a new checkout flow. Our current trial account balance will exhaust early in the run.

Can Redwood provision an emergency top-up: roughly 150k tokens (or equivalent sandbox credits) scoped to the lumencart-staging project for a 48-hour window? We will share telemetry and a short report post-run.

Details attached (load-plan.xlsx) — contains traffic profile, IP allowlist, and telemetry hooks.

Diego / Sara — reviewed the load-plan. Technical notes:

- Token estimate: assuming 1.8k avg tokens per second at peak with 6-hour window (including KV cache misses and safety buffer), 150k tokens is reasonable as a conservative top-up. If payloads are larger we should provision an additional 25% headroom.
- Recommendation: pin to model variant rwin-3b-quant for staging to reduce per-token cost and avoid noisy kernel fallbacks.
- Batching: enable 20ms batching with continuous batching enabled — it will cut per-token cost and maintain P95 targets.
- Telemetry: send request IDs to /ingest/telemetry during run. We'll add a temporary tracing hook so we can correlate p95 spikes.

I've attached a minimal staging config that we can push to your project to pin the model and batching settings.

Karthik
